deadline_rule: No new config deadline later than this cut; earlier original deadlines remain earlier, no reset.

prompt_contract.fixed_text: Exact quoted parent block in v4 section6, including visible-feedback clause, useful organisation, broad permission and no compulsory catalogue.
prompt_contract.reader: Rereads Fn.md per call, verifies fixed text, hashes exact consumed bytes. Does not create real audited Fn files.
prompt_contract.head_update_validator: validate_head_update(previous,current): only FOCUS/STYLE/REFLECTION may change; GAME/NUDGING remain fixed.
prompt_contract.optional_companion: Fn.fields.json = {schema:ORCH_R114_HEAD_FIELDS_V1,prompt_sha256,fields}; match binds requested reflection settings; stale hash reports SETTINGS_MISMATCH_REPORT_ONLY without changing valid guidance.
prompt_contract.reflection_limit: Broker records requested reflection mode/budget only. Native owner applies settings prospectively and reports actual cap/exposure. Missing settings remain unspecified, never claimed applied. V4 quoted parent block does not contain a REFLECTION placeholder, so it is bound separately rather than appended to fixed parent prose.

open_turn: Accepted as TRAIN phase with actual child events required; no imagined child or prescribed goal is injected.
class_contract: intervention_class is free descriptive text or null; tag remains ADD/STOP/SHIFT. No behavior catalogue is shown or required. No semantic class is coerced; legacy plan rationale uses exact label or unclassified. Native grid consumers must not impose the previous enum.
visibility: Child-received game/checker feedback retained, explicit hidden evaluation fields removed. DEV head-only for parenting adaptation; FINAL never parent/head/exchange. Evaluation does not gate child continuation.
reporting: Existing per-request prompt/settings bindings and publication receipts; hourly reduction distinguishes delivered/MISSING/late and requires native evidence for child tokens/optimizer steps.
native_integration_status: Still requires audited Fn files, lane adapter integration, watcher-relayed DONE and receiver admission; CPU readiness is not launch approval.
